# KCC (Kindle Comic Converter)

This mod adds KCC and its multitude of ebook processing (upscale, stretch, right to left for manga...) to Calibre Web, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `calibre-web` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:calibre-web-kcc
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:calibre-web-kcc|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/calibre-web-kcc/
